cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Frontal sinus
cards.section: Paranasal sinuses, conchae and openings (a–p)
cards.label: a

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Within the frontal bone above the nasal root and orbits.
cards.section: Paranasal sinuses, conchae and openings (a–p)
cards.label: a

cards.question: Drainage
cards.answer: Drains to the middle meatus via the frontonasal pathway.
cards.section: Paranasal sinuses, conchae and openings (a–p)
cards.label: a

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Closely related to the anterior cranial fossa and orbit.
cards.section: Paranasal sinuses, conchae and openings (a–p)
cards.label: a

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Crista galli
cards.section: Paranasal sinuses, conchae and openings (a–p)
cards.label: b

cards.question: Bone
cards.answer: Midline projection of the ethmoid bone.
cards.section: Paranasal sinuses, conchae and openings (a–p)
cards.label: b

cards.question: Attachments
cards.answer: Provides anterior attachment for the falx cerebri.
cards.section: Paranasal sinuses, conchae and openings (a–p)
cards.label: b

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Cribriform plate
cards.section: Paranasal sinuses, conchae and openings (a–p)
cards.label: c

cards.question: Bone
cards.answer: Part of the ethmoid bone forming the roof of the nasal cavity.
cards.section: Paranasal sinuses, conchae and openings (a–p)
cards.label: c

cards.question: Contents
cards.answer: Perforated by olfactory nerve filaments passing to the olfactory bulb.
cards.section: Paranasal sinuses, conchae and openings (a–p)
cards.label: c

cards.question: Clinical relevance
cards.answer: Fracture may cause anosmia and CSF rhinorrhoea.
cards.section: Paranasal sinuses, conchae and openings (a–p)
cards.label: c

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Superior nasal concha
cards.section: Paranasal sinuses, conchae and openings (a–p)
cards.label: d

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Upper part of the lateral nasal wall.
cards.section: Paranasal sinuses, conchae and openings (a–p)
cards.label: d

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Increases mucosal surface area and creates airflow turbulence.
cards.section: Paranasal sinuses, conchae and openings (a–p)
cards.label: d

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Superior meatus lies inferior to it.
cards.section: Paranasal sinuses, conchae and openings (a–p)
cards.label: d

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Middle nasal concha
cards.section: Paranasal sinuses, conchae and openings (a–p)
cards.label: e

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Part of the ethmoid bone on the lateral nasal wall.
cards.section: Paranasal sinuses, conchae and openings (a–p)
cards.label: e

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Increases surface area and helps channel airflow around sinus drainage pathways.
cards.section: Paranasal sinuses, conchae and openings (a–p)
cards.label: e

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Middle meatus lies inferior to it.
cards.section: Paranasal sinuses, conchae and openings (a–p)
cards.label: e

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Uncinate process
cards.section: Paranasal sinuses, conchae and openings (a–p)
cards.label: f

cards.question: Bone
cards.answer: Curved process of the ethmoid bone.
cards.section: Paranasal sinuses, conchae and openings (a–p)
cards.label: f

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Forms part of the lateral wall of the middle meatus and helps define the hiatus semilunaris.
cards.section: Paranasal sinuses, conchae and openings (a–p)
cards.label: f

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Ethmoid bulla
cards.section: Paranasal sinuses, conchae and openings (a–p)
cards.label: g

cards.question: Bone
cards.answer: Rounded elevation formed by middle ethmoidal air cells.
cards.section: Paranasal sinuses, conchae and openings (a–p)
cards.label: g

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Projects into the middle meatus; middle ethmoidal cells commonly open onto it.
cards.section: Paranasal sinuses, conchae and openings (a–p)
cards.label: g

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Opening of ethmoid sinus
cards.section: Paranasal sinuses, conchae and openings (a–p)
cards.label: h

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Ethmoidal air cells open into the superior and middle meatuses depending on the cell group.
cards.section: Paranasal sinuses, conchae and openings (a–p)
cards.label: h

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Allows drainage and ventilation of ethmoidal sinuses.
cards.section: Paranasal sinuses, conchae and openings (a–p)
cards.label: h

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Location of opening to frontal sinus
cards.section: Paranasal sinuses, conchae and openings (a–p)
cards.label: i

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Drains through the frontal recess/frontonasal pathway into the middle meatus.
cards.section: Paranasal sinuses, conchae and openings (a–p)
cards.label: i

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Allows drainage and ventilation of the frontal sinus.
cards.section: Paranasal sinuses, conchae and openings (a–p)
cards.label: i

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: No label
cards.section: Paranasal sinuses, conchae and openings (a–p)
cards.label: j

cards.question: Model note
cards.answer: There is no labelled anatomical structure at this position on the model key.
cards.section: Paranasal sinuses, conchae and openings (a–p)
cards.label: j

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Maxillary sinus
cards.section: Paranasal sinuses, conchae and openings (a–p)
cards.label: k

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Within the body of the maxilla.
cards.section: Paranasal sinuses, conchae and openings (a–p)
cards.label: k

cards.question: Drainage
cards.answer: Drains into the middle meatus through the hiatus semilunaris.
cards.section: Paranasal sinuses, conchae and openings (a–p)
cards.label: k

cards.question: Clinical relevance
cards.answer: Its ostium is relatively high on the medial wall, which can impair drainage.
cards.section: Paranasal sinuses, conchae and openings (a–p)
cards.label: k

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Section of inferior nasal concha
cards.section: Paranasal sinuses, conchae and openings (a–p)
cards.label: l

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Inferior part of the lateral nasal wall.
cards.section: Paranasal sinuses, conchae and openings (a–p)
cards.label: l

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Increases surface area and turbulence for warming and humidifying inspired air.
cards.section: Paranasal sinuses, conchae and openings (a–p)
cards.label: l

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Inferior meatus lies beneath it.
cards.section: Paranasal sinuses, conchae and openings (a–p)
cards.label: l

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Nasolacrimal duct opening
cards.section: Paranasal sinuses, conchae and openings (a–p)
cards.label: m

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Opens into the inferior nasal meatus.
cards.section: Paranasal sinuses, conchae and openings (a–p)
cards.label: m

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Drains tears from the lacrimal sac into the nasal cavity.
cards.section: Paranasal sinuses, conchae and openings (a–p)
cards.label: m

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Sphenopalatine foramen
cards.section: Paranasal sinuses, conchae and openings (a–p)
cards.label: n

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Posterior part of the lateral nasal wall between sphenoid and palatine bones.
cards.section: Paranasal sinuses, conchae and openings (a–p)
cards.label: n

cards.question: Contents
cards.answer: Transmits sphenopalatine vessels and posterior superior nasal nerves.
cards.section: Paranasal sinuses, conchae and openings (a–p)
cards.label: n

cards.question: Clinical relevance
cards.answer: Sphenopalatine artery is a major source of posterior epistaxis.
cards.section: Paranasal sinuses, conchae and openings (a–p)
cards.label: n

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Greater palatine foramen
cards.section: Paranasal sinuses, conchae and openings (a–p)
cards.label: o

cards.question: Bone
cards.answer: Located in the palatine bone.
cards.section: Paranasal sinuses, conchae and openings (a–p)
cards.label: o

cards.question: Contents
cards.answer: Transmits greater palatine nerve and vessels.
cards.section: Paranasal sinuses, conchae and openings (a–p)
cards.label: o

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Opens onto the posterolateral hard palate.
cards.section: Paranasal sinuses, conchae and openings (a–p)
cards.label: o

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Sphenoidal sinus
cards.section: Paranasal sinuses, conchae and openings (a–p)
cards.label: p

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Within the body of the sphenoid bone.
cards.section: Paranasal sinuses, conchae and openings (a–p)
cards.label: p

cards.question: Drainage
cards.answer: Drains into the sphenoethmoidal recess.
cards.section: Paranasal sinuses, conchae and openings (a–p)
cards.label: p

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Pituitary gland lies superiorly; cavernous sinus and internal carotid arteries lie laterally.
cards.section: Paranasal sinuses, conchae and openings (a–p)
cards.label: p

cards.question: Clinical relevance
cards.answer: Provides a transsphenoidal route to the pituitary.
cards.section: Paranasal sinuses, conchae and openings (a–p)
cards.label: p

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Frontal bone
cards.section: Bones, conchae, meatuses and pharyngeal structures

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Forms the forehead, roof of orbit and part of anterior cranial fossa.
cards.section: Bones, conchae, meatuses and pharyngeal structures

cards.question: Articulations
cards.answer: Articulates with parietal, sphenoid, ethmoid, nasal, maxillary, lacrimal and zygomatic bones.
cards.section: Bones, conchae, meatuses and pharyngeal structures

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Ethmoid bone
cards.section: Bones, conchae, meatuses and pharyngeal structures

cards.question: Landmarks
cards.answer: Cribriform plate, crista galli, perpendicular plate and ethmoidal labyrinths.
cards.section: Bones, conchae, meatuses and pharyngeal structures

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Contributes to nasal septum, lateral nasal wall, medial orbital wall and anterior cranial floor.
cards.section: Bones, conchae, meatuses and pharyngeal structures

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Inferior nasal concha
cards.section: Bones, conchae, meatuses and pharyngeal structures

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Independent curved bone of the lateral nasal wall.
cards.section: Bones, conchae, meatuses and pharyngeal structures

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Increases mucosal surface area and airflow turbulence.
cards.section: Bones, conchae, meatuses and pharyngeal structures

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Lacrimal bone
cards.section: Bones, conchae, meatuses and pharyngeal structures

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Small bone of the medial orbital wall contributing to the lacrimal fossa.
cards.section: Bones, conchae, meatuses and pharyngeal structures

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Contributes to the bony passage for nasolacrimal drainage.
cards.section: Bones, conchae, meatuses and pharyngeal structures

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Nasal bone
cards.section: Bones, conchae, meatuses and pharyngeal structures

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Forms the bony bridge of the nose.
cards.section: Bones, conchae, meatuses and pharyngeal structures

cards.question: Articulations
cards.answer: Articulates with frontal bone, maxilla and opposite nasal bone.
cards.section: Bones, conchae, meatuses and pharyngeal structures

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Maxilla
cards.section: Bones, conchae, meatuses and pharyngeal structures

cards.question: Landmarks
cards.answer: Alveolar process, palatine process, infraorbital foramen and maxillary sinus.
cards.section: Bones, conchae, meatuses and pharyngeal structures

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Forms upper jaw, orbital floor, lateral nasal wall and anterior hard palate.
cards.section: Bones, conchae, meatuses and pharyngeal structures

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Palatine bone
cards.section: Bones, conchae, meatuses and pharyngeal structures

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Contributes to posterior hard palate, lateral nasal wall and floor of orbit.
cards.section: Bones, conchae, meatuses and pharyngeal structures

cards.question: Landmarks
cards.answer: Horizontal and perpendicular plates.
cards.section: Bones, conchae, meatuses and pharyngeal structures

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Sphenoid bone
cards.section: Bones, conchae, meatuses and pharyngeal structures

cards.question: Landmarks
cards.answer: Body, greater and lesser wings and pterygoid processes.
cards.section: Bones, conchae, meatuses and pharyngeal structures

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Contributes to skull base, orbit and posterior nasal region.
cards.section: Bones, conchae, meatuses and pharyngeal structures

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Nasal cartilages
cards.section: Bones, conchae, meatuses and pharyngeal structures

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Cartilaginous framework supporting the external nose.
cards.section: Bones, conchae, meatuses and pharyngeal structures

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Maintains nasal shape while allowing flexibility.
cards.section: Bones, conchae, meatuses and pharyngeal structures

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: No label
cards.section: Bones, conchae, meatuses and pharyngeal structures

cards.question: Model note
cards.answer: There is no labelled anatomical structure at this position on the model key.
cards.section: Bones, conchae, meatuses and pharyngeal structures

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Superior nasal concha
cards.section: Bones, conchae, meatuses and pharyngeal structures

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Upper lateral nasal wall.
cards.section: Bones, conchae, meatuses and pharyngeal structures

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Increases surface area and airflow turbulence.
cards.section: Bones, conchae, meatuses and pharyngeal structures

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Middle nasal concha
cards.section: Bones, conchae, meatuses and pharyngeal structures

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Lateral nasal wall, part of the ethmoid bone.
cards.section: Bones, conchae, meatuses and pharyngeal structures

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Helps direct airflow and defines the middle meatus.
cards.section: Bones, conchae, meatuses and pharyngeal structures

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Inferior nasal concha
cards.section: Bones, conchae, meatuses and pharyngeal structures

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Inferior lateral nasal wall.
cards.section: Bones, conchae, meatuses and pharyngeal structures

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Warms, humidifies and filters inspired air by increasing mucosal surface area.
cards.section: Bones, conchae, meatuses and pharyngeal structures

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Superior nasal meatus
cards.section: Bones, conchae, meatuses and pharyngeal structures

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Passage inferior to the superior nasal concha.
cards.section: Bones, conchae, meatuses and pharyngeal structures

cards.question: Drainage
cards.answer: Receives posterior ethmoidal air cells.
cards.section: Bones, conchae, meatuses and pharyngeal structures

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Middle nasal meatus
cards.section: Bones, conchae, meatuses and pharyngeal structures

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Passage inferior to the middle nasal concha.
cards.section: Bones, conchae, meatuses and pharyngeal structures

cards.question: Drainage
cards.answer: Receives frontal, maxillary and anterior/middle ethmoidal sinus drainage.
cards.section: Bones, conchae, meatuses and pharyngeal structures

cards.question: Landmarks
cards.answer: Contains structures including bulla ethmoidalis, uncinate process and hiatus semilunaris.
cards.section: Bones, conchae, meatuses and pharyngeal structures

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Inferior nasal meatus
cards.section: Bones, conchae, meatuses and pharyngeal structures

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Passage inferior to the inferior nasal concha.
cards.section: Bones, conchae, meatuses and pharyngeal structures

cards.question: Drainage
cards.answer: Receives the nasolacrimal duct.
cards.section: Bones, conchae, meatuses and pharyngeal structures

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Pharyngeal opening of auditory tube
cards.section: Bones, conchae, meatuses and pharyngeal structures

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Lateral wall of the nasopharynx.
cards.section: Bones, conchae, meatuses and pharyngeal structures

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Connects nasopharynx with middle ear and helps equalise middle-ear pressure.
cards.section: Bones, conchae, meatuses and pharyngeal structures

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Pharyngeal recess
cards.section: Bones, conchae, meatuses and pharyngeal structures

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Recess in the lateral nasopharyngeal wall posterior to the torus tubarius.
cards.section: Bones, conchae, meatuses and pharyngeal structures

cards.question: Also called
cards.answer: Fossa of Rosenmüller.
cards.section: Bones, conchae, meatuses and pharyngeal structures

cards.question: Clinical relevance
cards.answer: Important site in nasopharyngeal carcinoma.
cards.section: Bones, conchae, meatuses and pharyngeal structures

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Hard palate
cards.section: Bones, conchae, meatuses and pharyngeal structures

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Formed by palatine processes of the maxillae and horizontal plates of the palatine bones.
cards.section: Bones, conchae, meatuses and pharyngeal structures

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Separates oral and nasal cavities.
cards.section: Bones, conchae, meatuses and pharyngeal structures

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Soft palate
cards.section: Bones, conchae, meatuses and pharyngeal structures

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Muscular fibrous fold extending posteriorly from the hard palate.
cards.section: Bones, conchae, meatuses and pharyngeal structures

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Elevates during swallowing to close the nasopharynx and contributes to speech.
cards.section: Bones, conchae, meatuses and pharyngeal structures

cards.question: Innervation
cards.answer: Motor mainly via pharyngeal plexus except tensor veli palatini via V3.
cards.section: Bones, conchae, meatuses and pharyngeal structures

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Nasal vestibule
cards.section: Bones, conchae, meatuses and pharyngeal structures

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Most anterior part of the nasal cavity just inside the nostril.
cards.section: Bones, conchae, meatuses and pharyngeal structures

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Lined by skin and vibrissae before transitioning to respiratory mucosa.
cards.section: Bones, conchae, meatuses and pharyngeal structures

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Filters large inhaled particles.
cards.section: Bones, conchae, meatuses and pharyngeal structures

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Pharyngeal tonsil
cards.section: Bones, conchae, meatuses and pharyngeal structures

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Roof and posterior wall of the nasopharynx.
cards.section: Bones, conchae, meatuses and pharyngeal structures

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Part of Waldeyer's ring and mucosal immune defence.
cards.section: Bones, conchae, meatuses and pharyngeal structures

cards.question: Clinical relevance
cards.answer: Enlargement forms adenoids and may obstruct nasal breathing or auditory-tube function.
cards.section: Bones, conchae, meatuses and pharyngeal structures

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Palatine tonsil
cards.section: Bones, conchae, meatuses and pharyngeal structures

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Tonsillar fossa between palatoglossal and palatopharyngeal arches.
cards.section: Bones, conchae, meatuses and pharyngeal structures

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Part of Waldeyer's ring and mucosal immune defence.
cards.section: Bones, conchae, meatuses and pharyngeal structures

cards.question: Clinical relevance
cards.answer: Glossopharyngeal nerve lies close to the tonsillar bed.
cards.section: Bones, conchae, meatuses and pharyngeal structures

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Olfactory bulb
cards.section: Bones, conchae, meatuses and pharyngeal structures

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Inferior frontal-lobe surface above the cribriform plate.
cards.section: Bones, conchae, meatuses and pharyngeal structures

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Receives olfactory nerve input and begins central processing of smell.
cards.section: Bones, conchae, meatuses and pharyngeal structures

cards.question: Connections
cards.answer: Continues posteriorly as the olfactory tract.
cards.section: Bones, conchae, meatuses and pharyngeal structures

cards.question: Clinical relevance
cards.answer: Damage may cause anosmia.
cards.section: Bones, conchae, meatuses and pharyngeal structures

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Nasal septum
cards.section: Nasal septum

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Midline partition dividing the nasal cavity into right and left halves.
cards.section: Nasal septum

cards.question: Components
cards.answer: Formed mainly by the perpendicular plate of ethmoid, vomer and septal cartilage.
cards.section: Nasal septum

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Supports the nose and directs airflow through each nasal cavity.
cards.section: Nasal septum

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Vomer
cards.section: Nasal septum

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Posteroinferior bony part of the nasal septum.
cards.section: Nasal septum

cards.question: Articulations
cards.answer: Articulates with sphenoid, ethmoid, maxillae and palatine bones.
cards.section: Nasal septum

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Perpendicular plate of ethmoid bone
cards.section: Nasal septum

cards.question: Bone
cards.answer: Part of the ethmoid bone.
cards.section: Nasal septum

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Forms the superior bony part of the nasal septum.
cards.section: Nasal septum

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Septal cartilage
cards.section: Nasal septum

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Forms the anterior cartilaginous portion of the nasal septum.
cards.section: Nasal septum

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Provides flexible structural support to the anterior nose.
cards.section: Nasal septum
